summary.text: Leigh Hulsey, a Republican, has represented District 15 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, her career experience includes owning CrossFit Alabaster and Henley Developments, LLC.
She has served as president of the Alabaster Business Alliance and as an executive committee member of the Shelby County Republican Party.
